text: Some work isn't meant for one person. A new family's question can go to the whole client liaison team, and the first one free takes it. That's the Unassigned tab.
The one thing to remember: click Assign to me before you start, so two people don't do the same work.
Each card says which team's queue it's on.
Show picks one of your queues. You only see the queues for your roles.
Branch narrows it to your office.
This new family is waiting for a call back about cat visits.
It's off the queue, so nobody else picks it up.
Click Active. It's on your own list now.

The most common mistakes: working a queue task without assigning it to yourself first, and grabbing more than you can finish. If you can't get to it, Move it back to the queue. Remember: click Assign to me before you start.
